description: This file is the main view for a Database Viewer application, featuring a responsive layout with a sidebar for selecting databases and tables, and a content area to display data.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of available databases.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list and updates the UI.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Handles the opening and closing of database items in the sidebar.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for the selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data from the selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders the data in a table format within the content area.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders an individual cell in the table.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands a cell to show the full content.

methods.name: showLoading
methods.description: Displays a loading message in a specific element.

methods.name: showError
methods.description: Displays an error message in a specific element.

methods.name: showEmptyState
methods.description: Displays an empty state message in a specific element.

methods.name: setActiveState
methods.description: Sets an active state class on specific elements.
